mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.create_time, p.name AS product_name, p.cover AS product_image, p.price AS product_price, u.nickname FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN c_user u ON c.user_id = u.id ORDER BY c.id DESC
